description: Independent, collectively-led French asset manager (Marc de Saint-Denis, President; Philippe Krier and Sebastien Grasset, Directeurs Generaux) pursuing an active external-growth strategy. Acquired Trusteam Finance in 2025 (AMF-approved operation completed 2025-04-30, +EUR 600m AUM), following earlier acquisitions of Salamandre AM (2020, EUR 500m) and Phi IM plus IDAM (2024, ~EUR 140m combined). Reached ~EUR 5.3bn AUM end-2025 and has stated it intends to keep combining organic and external growth.

fit.reasoning: Fit 60/60 (max): priority segment asset manager (20) + priority market France (15) + multi-asset via combined equity/multi-strategy expertise across acquired boutiques (10) + manages third-party client money (10) + AMF-regulated (5). Trigger: no single row is a perfect fit - closest is 'visible growth' (8 of 25) - but the real, better-than-the-table hook is operational: four acquisitions since 2020 (Salamandre AM, Phi IM, IDAM, Trusteam Finance) means Auris is very likely running several legacy books/systems inherited from each target and actively needs to consolidate them onto one platform, which is exactly a front-to-back, single-database pitch. Access 8/15: named collective leadership (President and two Directeurs Generaux) identified via the company's own team page, not yet individually confirmed reachable. Total 60+8+8=76, moderated to 68 pending confirmation of which back-office systems the acquired entities currently run and whether a consolidation project is actually underway or already completed.
